hero_subtitle: A nationwide STEM, AI and Robotics competition for middle school students across Vietnam.
hero_desc: miniFAnRoC is the official operation platform for robotics competition management, match systems and tournament coordination.
cta_title: Build The Future With Robotics & AI
footer_brand_desc: Official operation platform for the FSchool AI and Robotics Challenge — Vietnam's nationwide STEM competition.
footer_about_desc: FSchool AI and Robotics Challenge is a nationwide STEM, AI and Robotics competition for middle school students across Vietnam.
about_desc: FAnRoC (FSchool AI and Robotics Challenge) is a nationwide STEM, AI and Robotics competition designed for middle school students to develop engineering mindset, teamwork and innovation skills.
about_objective_1_desc: Encouraging students to explore the wonders of science, technology and robotics.
about_objective_2_desc: Helping the next generation understand and apply AI technologies in real life.
about_objective_3_desc: Building strong engineering and problem-solving mindset through hands-on challenges.
about_objective_4_desc: Developing teamwork, leadership and communication skills under competitive pressure.
timeline_desc: Teams from across Vietnam will compete at regional hubs at FSchool campuses in Hanoi, Thanh Hoa, Da Nang and Can Tho before advancing to the National Finals at FSchool Hanoi.
timeline_1_desc: Register your team online. All required documents must be submitted before the deadline.
timeline_2_desc: Attend the official online training session to learn competition rules and robot design guidelines.
timeline_3_desc: Teams compete at regional FSchool hubs in Hanoi, Thanh Hoa, Da Nang and Can Tho.
timeline_4_desc: Top teams from all regions gather at FSchool Hanoi to compete for the national championship.
divisions_desc: Two divisions — one for FSchool students, one open to all middle schools across Vietnam.
divisions_internal_desc: Dedicated for FSchool middle school students nationwide. Compete with peers from the same educational ecosystem.
divisions_open_desc: Open for all middle school students from any school across Vietnam. Showcase your skills on the national stage.
cta_desc: Join Vietnam's next generation of innovators, engineers and technology leaders. Register your team today and compete on the national stage.
awards_desc: Recognizing excellence, innovation, and the spirit of engineering across all divisions.
awards_grand_desc: Presented to the most outstanding team in the entire competition — across both divisions. Includes a REV Robotics FTC Starter Kit.
awards_1_desc: Presented to the overall champion team of the national finals.
awards_2_desc: Awarded to the runner-up team demonstrating excellence throughout the competition.
awards_3_desc: Recognizes the team with the most creative and innovative robot design.
awards_4_desc: Celebrates outstanding newcomers who show exceptional promise and growth.
awards_special_1_desc: Awarded to the team demonstrating the most sustainable engineering practices.
awards_special_2_desc: Recognizes teams that embody the spirit of gracious professionalism on and off the field.
awards_special_3_desc: For the team making the best use of open-source technologies in their robot design.
awards_special_4_desc: Highlights groundbreaking engineering solutions and novel technical approaches.
awards_special_5_desc: Honors the best overall robot design considering functionality and aesthetics.
awards_special_6_desc: Recognizes the most thorough and professional technical documentation.
sponsors_desc: Organized by FPT Corporation & FSchool. Made possible by our sponsors.
awards_grand_prize: Prize: REV Robotics FTC Starter Kit + [ Cash prize TBA ]
map_desc: Four regional hubs across Vietnam, bringing the competition close to every student.
map_region_thanhhoa_subtitle: Thanh Hoa · Nghe An · Ha Tinh
map_finals_desc: The strongest teams from the regional qualifiers advance to compete together in the National Finals at FSchool Hanoi.
placeholder_teams_desc: The public team list will be available after registration data is finalized.

placeholder_resources_desc: Guides, templates, and team support materials will be added here soon.
placeholder_matches_desc: Public match information will be available here once the competition schedule is ready.
register_page_description: Register one representative account for a miniFAnRoC team.
register_description: Use the email of the team representative. Each registration can include up to 4 students and 1 teacher mentor.
register_success_desc: Your team information has been captured locally. Backend submission can be connected when the registration API is ready.
register_team_name_min: Team name must be at least 3 characters.
register_student_count_range: Student count must be from 1 to 4.
register_mentor_email_invalid: Enter a valid mentor email address.
